prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a slow, steady movement forward along a snowy trail under the night sky. The camera pans slightly upward, revealing a dense canopy of trees silhouetted against the dark, starlit expanse. Snowflakes gently drift through the air, catching the faint light and creating a serene, almost ethereal atmosphere. As the viewer progresses, the camera tilts downward, focusing on the uneven terrain covered in a layer of fresh snow, with occasional rocks and patches of exposed earth breaking the white blanket. The path winds gently, and the camera follows this curve, capturing the subtle interplay of shadows cast by the sparse moonlight filtering through the branches above. The surrounding environment remains quiet and undisturbed, with no other figures in sight. The camera then shifts its focus to a set of wooden steps partially buried in snow, leading upwards into the forest. The viewer ascends these steps, the camera angle adjusting to show the ascent from a lower to a higher vantage point. The scene transitions smoothly as the camera pans to the right, revealing a wider view of the snowy landscape stretching out into the distance, framed by the dark outlines of distant mountains. The entire sequence maintains a consistent, tranquil pace, emphasizing the isolation and beauty of the nocturnal, wintry setting.
